exposure: soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1 / placental growth factor ratios
cohort: 37 pregnancies from 27 kidney transplant recipients who delivered after 20 weeks gestation at a quaternary hospital in Victoria, Australia, between 2000 and 2022
finding: Kidney transplant recipients experienced high rates of pre-existing hypertension, pregnancy-induced hypertension, pre-eclampsia, preterm birth, caesarean birth, and postpartum hemorrhage, but no graft rejection within one year of birth.
mod_finding: Unplanned caesarean without labor was the most common mode of birth (35.1%), and the overall caesarean rate was 62.1%.
